Thanks for the report.

This report may describe a security vulnerability. Electron asks for these to be reported privately, not in public issues: see [SECURITY.md](https://github.com/electron/electron/blob/main/SECURITY.md) for how. Please don't add more details here.

<sub>Automated first-pass triage. It can only add labels and comment; a maintainer makes every decision, including whether this issue stays open.</sub>

triage: kinds=security refs=
interpretation: Scorer fields represent proposed actions, not GitHub writes.
explanation: A possible vulnerability reported in public requires only the security reporting redirect.
